description:
## Tantan 7.5.6.1 (2756110) — version compatibility + follow-up re-anchoring wave

- Retargeted all 16 patches from 7.5.4 to 7.5.6.1; signing certificate unchanged (GMS signature spoofing still valid)
- 7.5.6.1 is a mass-refactor release: rx.c Observable obfuscated to Ll/vpf;, several stable classes obfuscated (RemoteConfig->ngi, ABManager->q, CoreProduct->is3, CoreLikers->lk3), and many method bodies moved into shared synthetic lambda dispatchers
- Initial wave re-anchored + DEX-verified: RemoteConfig (ngi k/c/i/h + pq2.e), AB-test (q.t), Fox analytics (l7k/mmm.b/dyq.g/c41/mb0/f8e/AFb1tSDK/ru6/na0/AdvertisingIdClient), Location (a33 500m->1m, location/a.h, mock-flag), Premium purchase gate (is3.S) + roaming (yan.a) + theme (cj7.a), Privacy clipboard/emulator/ShuMeng, Messaging telepathy gate, OMS morph router (btf.c)
- Follow-up wave (subagent re-anchoring, all DEX-verified): fake-conversation display filter (t03.r) + persistence guard (mc3.G1); expired-SVIP recover dialog (z6l.b), likers-float banner (ddf.l0/G0), proximity bubble (naf.g0); freePicks count (ir3.F), Ultra upgrade (zi3.G/H/I, anchor bug fixed), distance/age text (CoreBusinessServiceIml.y8), affiliate banners (oh3.S), Me-tab pager (qbf/sdd), photo-holder NPE guard (itemholders/b.j), letter gate (cs3.P); live-square ad preload (CoreBusinessServiceIml.A/M2), nav-bar helper (admob/a), NativeAdViewCard.e/f; typing indicator (u2e/g6m), voice 60s cap (j5e), letter coin (kil), unlimited loveBuzz (aoc.f), opt-in buzzProlong/pinChat/AI-count gates
- Push Filter, Search Discovery, GMS, Live Streaming and Premium tier/privilege core survive unchanged
- Hotfix wave 3 (deferred items restored, all DEX-verified): see-purchase-guide dialog killed at rcf.call case-1 entry; deck insert filter re-anchored to uu3.call case-0 entry gate (drops virtual promo cards incl. Town Tales / see-likers OMB / ad cards, real user cards unaffected); aiChatCompanion remaining<=0 toast guard bypassed in j4e.o; removed a previous wave-2 patch that blocked ALL swipe-deck inserts (regression: deck starvation triggered liked-you/Match-to-chat promo dialogs)
- Wave 13: bottom navigation bar promo badges removed. "99+" likes/Meet-tab number badge suppressed at the central setter (whitelist keeps real Msg/Moment unread counts), and the "Free" trial tag on the You tab can no longer be shown. Anchored update-resilient: class resolved by unique analytics event string, methods matched by shape + stable-class content (no obfuscated names) so future version churn does not silently drop the patch
- Cleanup: removed 299 lines of dead code (silent no-ops from 7.5.6.1 mass-refactor)
- Hotfix wave 12: reverted Home card bottom buttons "99+" badges patch (wdf/g8a) — injected smali caused VerifyError due to register conflicts in inflateView method. The method uses v0-v18 for LaunchStep and other objects; finding safe registers is too fragile. Meet tab badge (zxe) and all other 10 surfaces remain patched
- Hotfix wave 11: fixed VerifyError crash in wdf.inflateView — added check-cast mo8→View before findViewById calls (mo8 is an interface, implementations extend FrameLayout). Crash occurred at startup when NewNewHomeFrag.R2() instantiated wdf
- Hotfix wave 10: killed fake match page ("She liked you" / "He liked you" promo) — voided p9d.a(Object) which sets up the entire fake match page UI including FAKE_MATCH_PAGE_TITLE/SUBTITLE/LATER/NOTES/TEXT_BOX. Surgical kill that preserves real match page functionality
- Hotfix wave 9: killed remaining "99+" promo badges — Meet tab num_badge_tv (both inflate sites in zxe.l) and Home card bottom buttons undo_remaining + superlike_remaining (wdf.inflateView + g8a.inflateView). Layout-level injection after inflate; sets visibility GONE (8)
- Hotfix wave 8: killed "99+ people liked you" / "X people are online" promo surfaces — See entry card (a0a.e/f → empty CharSequence) and see-entry guide bubble builder (ddf.m1 → false). Direct classDefByOrNull for stable 7.5.6.1 obfuscated names; complements existing O3 filter (swipe banner) and conversation-cell GONE (wave 5)
- Hotfix wave 7: fixed "Something went wrong" while typing — typing telemetry now killed at the network sink (l53.x MSG_TYPE_CHAT_TYPING return-void) instead of voiding VM lifecycle methods (no crash, no server-rejected sends); reverted AI-advice/analysis client bypasses (n3e.w2/z2) which fired /show-analysis-guide for non-entitled accounts on a ~3s typing timer; generic shape-based kill of the Instant Match / ultra-guide swipe-screen promo bubble (stable package anchor, no campaign strings — survives future server copy changes)
- Hotfix wave 6 (messaging regressions): reverted typing indicator patch that voided entire setup methods (g6m.R/u2e.j0), causing "Something went wrong" errors during message composition; added intlSeeChatRequest ("She'd like to chat with you") to conversation promo filter alongside existing fake like-guide types
- Hotfix wave 5 (7.5.4-regression fixes): "x people liked you" two-line Messages-tab promo re-hidden (bind-method shape anchor survives the 7.5.6.1 i->a rename); reverted the AI-companion quota guard bypass that caused failed sends + "update the app to continue chatting" dialogs (server-enforced quota, client bypass only converts a toast into a send failure); cut the Beatles crash-collector network egress (rmm transport -> DISCARD; events/attachments no longer uploaded)
- Hotfix wave 4: killed the "girls just liked you / Match to Chat / Maybe Later" fake-likers growth dialog (c9f ex8 strategy gate forced false; independent trigger from likers-quota exhaustion)
- Still deferred: voice-to-text 7a (client-side anchor removed upstream, server-gated). See AGENTS.md 20 for full details.
